kurals.tr: Vinaivaliyum Thanvaliyum Maatraan Valiyum / Thunaivaliyum Thookkich Cheyal
kurals.m: Let (one) weigh well the strength of the deed (he purposes to do), his own strength, the strength of his enemy, and the strength of the allies (of both), and then let him act

kurals.tr: Olva Tharivadhu Arindhadhan Kandhangich / Chelvaarkkuch Chellaadhadhu Il
kurals.m: There is nothing which may not be accomplished by those who, before they attack (an enemy), make themselves acquainted with their own ability, and with whatever else is (needful) to be known, and

kurals.tr: Utaiththam Valiyariyaar Ookkaththin Ookki / Itaikkan Murindhaar Palar
kurals.m: There are many who, ignorant of their (want of) power (to meet it), have haughtily set out to war, and broken down in the midst of it

kurals.tr: Amaindhaang Kozhukaan Alavariyaan Thannai / Viyandhaan Viraindhu Ketum
kurals.m: He will quickly perish who, ignorant of his own resources flatters himself of his greatness, and does

kurals.tr: Peelipey Saakaatum Achchirum Appantanjjch / Aala Mikuththup Peyin
kurals.m: The axle tree of a bandy, loaded only with peacocks' feathers will break, if it be greatly overloaded

kurals.tr: Nunikkompar Erinaar Aqdhiran Thookkin / Uyirkkirudhi Aaki Vitum
kurals.m: There will be an end to the life of him who, having climbed out to the end of a branch, ventures to go further

kurals.tr: Aatrin Aravarindhu Eeka Adhuporul / Potri Vazhangu Neri
kurals.m: Let a man know the measure of his ability (to give), and let him give accordingly; such giving is the way to preserve his property

kurals.tr: Aakaaru Alavitti Thaayinung Ketillai / Pokaaru Akalaak Katai
kurals.m: Even though the income (of a king) be small, it will not cause his (ruin), if his outgoings be not larger than his income

kurals.tr: Alavara�ndhu Vaazhaadhaan Vaazhkkai Ulapola / Illaakith Thondraak Ketum
kurals.m: The prosperity of him who lives without knowing the measure (of his property), will perish, even while it seems to continue

kurals.tr: Ulavarai Thookkaadha Oppura Vaanmai / Valavarai Vallaik Ketum
kurals.m: The measure of his wealth will quickly perish, whose liberality weighs not the measure of his property
